title: Part 11 : 2023: Methods For Quantitative Description Of Discontinuities In Rock Masses - Part 11 Core Recovery And Rock Quality Designation
clause_1_scope: This standard (Part 11) covers the method for the determination of core recovery, and Rock Quality Designation (RQD).
